title: VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.28617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training data is a bottleneck in AI, especially for large language models (LLMs) that write Verilog, because register-transfer-level (RTL) code is rarely published and existing datasets mostly check code for syntax, not instruction correctness. This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset, and the multi-agent framework that builds it, in which LLM agents write and revise specifications, and EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker) decide what is accepted. Its levels follow an engineer's checks. Level 1 labels designs from two large Verilog corpora, namely RTLCoder and PyraNet, with synthesis results, failure causes, critical warnings and post-synthesis metrics. 28% of RTLCoder designs fail synthesis and are kept as negatives. translated_title: VeriLadder：一个用于工具验证Verilog数据集的多智能体规格细化系统
translated_abstract: 训练数据是人工智能领域的瓶颈，对于编写Verilog代码的大型语言模型（LLM）尤为如此，因为寄存器传输级（RTL）代码很少公开发表，且现有数据集大多只检查代码的语法正确性，而非指令本身的正确性。本文提出了VeriLadder——一个五级Verilog数据集，以及构建该数据集的多智能体框架。在该框架中，LLM智能体负责编写和修订规格说明，而EDA工具（综合器和形式等价性检查器）决定哪些内容被接受。其分级遵循工程师的检查流程。第一级对来自两个大型Verilog语料库（RTLCoder和PyraNet）的设计进行标注，包括综合结果、失败原因、关键警告和综合后指标。RTLCoder中28%的设计无法通过综合，这些设计被保留作为负样本。第二级依据四项规格质量指标对每条指令进行评分，低分预示着重建会失败。第三级将每条指令重写为精细化的规格说明并接受它。
tldr: 本文提出VeriLadder，一个五级Verilog数据集及其多智能体构建框架，由LLM智能体编写和修订规格说明，并由综合器与形式等价性检查器等EDA工具进行验证，从而解决了编写Verilog的LLM缺乏高质量训练数据的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset and multi-agent framework in which LLM agents write and refine specifications that are verified by EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker), addressing the bottleneck of quality training data for LLMs that write Verilog.
